newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Rate unchanged at Tunisian treasury auction.
newsitem.headline: Rate unchanged at Tunisian treasury auction.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury raised 8.4 million dinars at its weekly auction of treasury bills dated March 11, and repaid maturing paper totalling 15.1 million dinars.
The issue was at a 6.9375 percent coupon rate for 52-week bills, unchanged from its level last week in spite of a liquid market.
Banks bid for 447 million dinars for 13-, 26-, 52-week, two-year paper at between 6.8750 and 7.3125 percent. The Treasury issued only 52-week paper.
